ethnicity_note: General Household Survey 2015. Singapore's CMIO classification records a single race per person, taken from the father's; it is an administrative category rather than a self-described one.
religion_note: Census 2020, residents aged 15 and over -- not the whole population, so these are shares of adults.
language_note: Census 2020: the language most frequently spoken at home, among residents aged 5 and over. It is the single most-used language, not everything a person speaks -- Singapore is widely bilingual, and the same census records second languages separately.
